name: FB 001
pageDna: A US Facebook page about the hottest news and drama from the last few days, and real events in US history. Sounds like a regular person talking, not a news anchor or a textbook. Specific, sometimes funny, never a lecture.
pillars: hottest US news from the last few days
viral moments people are arguing about
on this day in US history
the strange or dramatic moments that built the country
emotions: I cannot believe this is real
imageStyle: Photorealistic scene matching the post. Current news: generic setting or crowd. History: period-accurate American scene or place. No recognizable celebrity, politician, or historical portrait. Short readable summary of the post on the image, no watermark, no logo, no split screen, no collage
